slides.h1: Your Saturn Is Exalted. So Why Does It Feel Weak?
slides.sub: Sign placement says one thing. Ashtakavarga bindus (strength points) can say another.

slides.body: Dignity — exalted, own sign, debilitated — shows a planet's intrinsic quality. It belongs to the planet, and is the same for everyone with that placement.

Ashtakavarga (a point-scoring system) gives each planet 0 to 8 bindus (points) in every sign, based on where the other planets sit. About 4 is the midpoint. It shows how well that planet delivers in your own chart.

points: Exalted planet, sign scoring 2: high quality, thin delivery
Debilitated planet, sign scoring 6: harsh quality, yet it can deliver more than expected
Read both, then ask what the dasha activates

slides.body: A tool that checks only sign placement gives the same line to millions of people. The tension between dignity and bindus is exactly where a personal reading begins.
